partners-showcase.looks: A heading and intro, a continuously scrolling strip of partner logos, then quote cards from partners (logo, quote, name, title), and an optional button.
partners-showcase.use: Corporate partners and what they say about NCMEC.
partners-showcase.avoid: Logos with no quotes: use Logo Carousel.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Our Partners'.
fields.ctaText: Optional button under the quotes, e.g. 'Become a Partner', with ctaLink.

fields.itemType: logo (default) for the scrolling strip; testimonial for a quote card. Add logos first, then testimonials.
fields.logoLink: Optional link to the partner's site.
fields.attributionName: Testimonial items only: who said it.
fields.attributionTitle: Testimonial items only: their role and company.
